zones.name: The Latter Day Saint Movement
zones.subtitle: Mormonism · from 1830 · ~17 million
zones.blurb: The Restoration founded by Joseph Smith. Its scriptures are unambiguously public-domain — only the modern LDS typeset apparatus (chapter headings, footnotes, the Topical Guide) is copyright, never the text itself.

zones.name: Restorationist & Adventist
zones.subtitle: 19th-century American Christianity, remade
zones.blurb: The wave of new churches that grew from American Protestantism — each producing a new distinct scripture or authoritative canon. Almost all are green; only the mid-20th-century New World Translation is corporately held.

zones.name: Spiritualist, Spiritist & Esoteric
zones.subtitle: the channeled & the revealed
zones.blurb: The revealed and channeled cluster — new bibles dictated by spirits or masters, and the metaphysical currents (Theosophy, New Thought) that grew alongside them. A near-solid green front, their founders all long dead.
